clue.text: Tommy gets a regular allowance without doing any work for it

definitions.text: a regular allowance without doing any work for it

parts.note: a Tommy is a British common soldier, from Tommy Atkins
what a person gets coming in each year is their earnings or receipts

explanation.surface: A British soldier is handed a steady allowance for doing nothing.
explanation.walkthrough: Tommy (from Tommy Atkins) is the old nickname for a British common soldier; 'gets' stands for what comes in, his earnings.
explanation.definitionFit: Unearned money from investments or inheritance, paid regularly to someone who need not work, is the sense described.

clue.text: It goes up and down, and round and round

definitions.note: the definition describes something that spins round and round, a noun for a spinning thing

indicators.note: in a down clue the word reads the same going up the grid as going down it, so it is a palindrome

parts.note: the definition describes something that spins round and round, a noun for a spinning thing

explanation.surface: Something that bobs up and down and also spins in circles.
explanation.walkthrough: 'goes up and down' sounds like motion, but in a down entry it means the letters read the same upwards as downwards.
explanation.definitionFit: A spinning device or muscle turns continually about an axis.

clue.text: Repair a siren

definitions.meaning: to patch up or renovate
a seductive woman who lures men

explanation.definitionFit: To patch up old shoes or things is one sense; a seductress who beguiles men is the other, short for vampire.

clue.text: After an examination tucked into a meal with a will

indicators.note: the eating comes after the examination, so its letters follow

parts.note: an examination is a test
to tuck into a meal is to eat it, past tense ate

explanation.surface: Someone sits an exam, then enjoys a hearty meal with gusto.
explanation.definitionFit: A person who dies leaving a valid legal will is described by this legal term.

clue.text: Mark how the egocentric journalist introduces himself

parts.note: an egocentric speaker begins with I'm, talking about himself
the press stands for journalists collectively

explanation.surface: A self-important reporter introducing himself to people.
explanation.walkthrough: The journalist introduces himself as 'I'm press', which run together gives the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: To stamp or imprint a mark on something is to make an impression on it.

clue.text: About fifty join an extended family group

parts.note: C stands for circa, Latin for about
L is the Roman numeral for fifty

explanation.surface: Around fifty people come together to form a large family.
explanation.definitionFit: A Scottish kinship group descended from a common ancestor is a large extended family.

clue.text: Sailor is a good friend to Abraham's nephew

parts.note: a mate is a good friend
in Genesis, Lot is the nephew of Abraham

explanation.surface: A seaman who has befriended a Bible character.
explanation.walkthrough: Lot, whose wife was turned to a pillar of salt, was Abraham's nephew in the Bible.
explanation.definitionFit: This is informal British slang, from French, for a seaman in the navy.

clue.text: Cosmopolitan sophisticate

definitions.meaning: worldly, at home in many countries
a worldly, experienced person

explanation.definitionFit: A worldly, experienced person who is at ease in any society fits both descriptions.

clue.text: Complaint resulting somehow from a nameless germ

indicators.note: somehow says the letters arrive by some unstated rearrangement

explanation.surface: An illness that comes from an anonymous microbe.
explanation.definitionFit: Rubella is a mild viral illness, and a complaint is an ailment.

clue.text: On occasions a cross letter is written to a paper

parts.note: the letter T is shaped like a cross
The Times is a newspaper

explanation.surface: An angry letter is sometimes sent to a newspaper.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cross letter' suggests an angry complaint, but it is the cross-shaped letter T.
explanation.definitionFit: Now and then, occasionally, is the meaning of this phrase.

clue.text: Soft childish toy results in childish chatter

parts.note: p (piano) is the musical marking for soft
a rattle is a baby's toy

explanation.surface: A soft toy for a child leads to baby talk.
explanation.definitionFit: Foolish, inconsequential talk, as of a child, is babble.

clue.text: He is a bespectacled teetotaller

annotationWithheld.why: He is a bespectacled teetotaller: TT inside OO, but 'bespectacled' must both supply OO (spectacles) and signal the containment, one word doing two jobs

clue.text: Afterwards discovered to be dead right

parts.note: the late so-and-so is someone dead

explanation.surface: Someone is later found to have been dead right all along.
explanation.definitionFit: Subsequently, at a following time, is the sense.

clue.text: Spare the Field Marshal

definitions.meaning: lean and thin, as a spare figure
Field Marshal William ..., British commander in Burma in the Second World War

explanation.definitionFit: Thin is one sense; William Slim, commander of the Fourteenth Army in Burma, is the other.

clue.text: Thanks to Augustus it's a current asset in Portugal

parts.note: ta is British informal for thanks
Gus is a short form of the name Augustus

explanation.surface: Thanks to an emperor, Portugal gains a valuable resource.
explanation.walkthrough: 'current' means a flow of water: this river flows through Spain and Portugal to Lisbon.
explanation.definitionFit: The Iberian river flowing through Lisbon is a feature of Portugal with a current.

clue.text: Wait for Jack by the railway

indicators.note: by means next to, so the railway sits beside the sailor

parts.note: a jack tar is a sailor, so Jack gives tar
RY is an abbreviation of railway

explanation.surface: Someone waits at the station for a friend called Jack.
explanation.definitionFit: To linger or stay somewhere longer is to delay.

clue.text: Traitor sent back twice to the East. What a sauce!

indicators.note: twice says the traitor's word appears two times over
sent back says the letters are written in reverse order

parts.note: a rat is a traitor or informer
E is the abbreviation for east

explanation.surface: A turncoat is twice deported eastwards, to the speaker's outrage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'What a sauce!' reads as an exclamation at the traitor's cheek, but the definition is the cold sauce served with fish.
explanation.definitionFit: A mayonnaise with chopped capers and gherkins served with fish is this sauce.

clue.text: Fight and beat an old Greek

parts.note: to spar is to fight or box
to tan someone's hide is to beat them

explanation.surface: Battling and defeating an ancient Greek warrior.
explanation.definitionFit: A citizen of ancient Sparta, the Greek city-state, is meant.

clue.text: Replacing this part of a vehicle can drain one's resources

definitions.meaning: the pipe carrying away waste gases from a car's engine
to use up completely

explanation.surface: Fitting a new car part can be ruinously expensive.
explanation.definitionFit: A car's tailpipe system is one sense; to use up resources completely is the other.

clue.text: Henry goes to a shady glade for shelter

parts.note: H is the symbol for the henry, the unit of inductance
an arbour is a shady garden retreat of trees or climbing plants

explanation.surface: A man named Henry seeks cover in a shaded clearing.
explanation.definitionFit: A port or haven where ships take refuge is a place of protection.

clue.text: Shouted to be given medical attention

definitions.meaning: in British and Australian slang to shout is to buy a round of drinks for others
cared for by a doctor

explanation.definitionFit: Bought someone a drink, as in 'it's my shout', is one sense; cared for by a doctor is the other.

clue.text: Dark-red automobile belongs to me

parts.note: an automobile is a car
what belongs to me is mine

explanation.surface: Someone proudly owns a deep red motor car.
explanation.definitionFit: A deep crimson colour, from cochineal dye, is the shade named.

clue.text: In them students may learn about social divisions

definitions.meaning: lessons or groups in which pupils are taught
strata of society, such as working or middle

explanation.definitionFit: Teaching sessions are one sense; strata of society are the other.

clue.text: Furious bombardment of Iran over a protracted period

indicators.note: a bombardment knocks things about, so the letters are scattered

parts.note: an age is a very long time

explanation.surface: A long military attack on Iran goes on for ages.
explanation.definitionFit: Very angry, livid with temper, is the meaning.

clue.text: Monster held in so great a dread

indicators.note: held in says the letters are contained within the words that follow

explanation.surface: A beast that inspires great fear.
explanation.definitionFit: A man-eating giant of folklore is a monster.

clue.text: Lamed in conflict, but got a military decoration

indicators.note: in conflict suggests the letters are at war and thrown out of order

explanation.surface: A soldier crippled in battle but awarded an honour.
explanation.definitionFit: A metal disc awarded for bravery or service is a decoration.

clue.text: The service which attracts a throng of people?

definitions.meaning: the Eucharist service in the Catholic church
a large crowd or body

explanation.definitionFit: The Catholic Eucharist is one sense; a large crowd is the other.

clue.text: Large numbers of them are found in auction-rooms

definitions.meaning: a great many
items offered for sale one by one at auction

explanation.definitionFit: A great many is one sense; items put up for bidding at auction are the other.

clue.text: Made notes on an old piece of Chinese porcelain

definitions.meaning: voiced musical notes, past participle of the verb for singing

definitions.text: an old piece of Chinese porcelain
definitions.meaning: ware from the Song dynasty of China, 960 to 1279

explanation.definitionFit: Vocalised melody is one sense; porcelain from China's medieval dynasty is the other.

clue.text: Sentry gets instruction to watch it

definitions.meaning: a guard on watch
a warning to be careful

explanation.definitionFit: A guard posted to keep watch is one sense; a warning to beware is the other.

clue.text: Serving it at mealtimes may be a Salvation Army custom

definitions.note: the definition describes a food put on the plate at meals, a noun

parts.note: usage is custom or habitual practice

explanation.surface: Serving food at meals could be a charitable organisation's habit.
explanation.walkthrough: The Salvation Army is known for serving meals, which makes the surface plausible; the definition is the food served.
explanation.definitionFit: A banger, minced meat in a skin, is a common food served at meals.

clue.text: One who aims to set new fashions

definitions.text: One who aims to set new fashions

parts.words: One who aims to set new fashions
parts.note: reads as a trend-setter in general, but describes a professional who creates new clothes

explanation.definitionFit: A couturier creates new styles of clothing and so sets the fashions.
